{{Top|leg}}
'''Joh''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Merchant/Legends|seller]] active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The shop [[Seelana's Droids]] in the village [[Tathin]] on Cularin had an arrangement with Joh whereby droids ordered in the shop would be supplied by Joh.<ref name="Shadows in Green">{{LivingForce|Shadows in Green}} </ref> Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''[[Shadows in Green]]'' can hence be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> Joh was present in Seelana's Droids during festivities accompanying the ''[[Bazaar Star Challenge/Legends|Bazaar Star Challenge]]'' [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] event.<ref name="Shadows in Green" />
